---
title: "Getting to work"
description: "Working from home, and how people travel to work, in each county."
image: ../images/social/economy-work-from-home-map.png
---

At the 2022 census, 36% of people at work said they worked from home for at least part of the week. The share was highest in Dublin, at 46%, and lowest in Monaghan, at 23%.

{{< chart economy-work-from-home-map >}}

Among people who travelled to work, 69% went by car. Driving was least common in Dublin, at 52%, and most common in Leitrim, Roscommon and Clare, at between 78% and 80%.

{{< chart economy-car-to-work-map >}}

The [Transport](../transport/index.qmd) pages show how people travel to work and school across Ireland, how this changed between 2016 and 2022, and how many journeys are made by bus, rail and Luas.
